exercises.hint: Use I/you + base verb. Negative = don't + verb.
exercises.explanation: I drink / You eat / I don't drink / You don't eat…

items.label: a
items.original: Eu bebo café todas as manhãs.

items.label: d
items.original: Você não come panquecas no café da manhã.
answers: You don't eat pancakes for breakfast
You don't eat pancakes for breakfast.
You do not eat pancakes for breakfast
You do not eat pancakes for breakfast.
You don't eat pancakes at breakfast

exercises.hint: Keep Simple Present. For questions, use Do you…?
exercises.explanation: You eat… and I eat… / I don't eat… / Do you drink…? No, I drink…

items.label: f
items.original: Você come biscoitos e eu como presunto.
answers: You eat cookies and I eat ham
You eat cookies and I eat ham.
You eat biscuits and I eat ham
You eat biscuits and I eat ham.

items.label: h
items.original: Você bebe suco? Não, eu bebo leite.
answers: Do you drink juice? No, I drink milk
Do you drink juice? No, I drink milk.
Do you drink juice? No I drink milk
Do you drink juice? No I drink milk.

items.label: i
items.original: Eu como panquecas e bebo café com leite.
answers: I eat pancakes and drink coffee with milk
I eat pancakes and drink coffee with milk.
I eat pancakes and I drink coffee with milk
I eat pancakes and I drink coffee with milk.

items.label: j
answers: Do you eat cookies, and me?
